entries.reason: Single Responsibility — Draft focuses on one concern: making finalize report display reliable via CLI-based retrieval.; Unambiguous Requirements — Most requirements are concrete and testable (target files, command behavior, exit conditions).; Complete Context — Requirements are listed as scope bullets but many do not explicitly pair trigger conditions with shall-style expected behavior.; No Hardcoded Secrets — No API keys, passwords, tokens, or similar secrets are present in the draft content.; Prioritize Requirements — More than three requirement items are present without an explicit priority order.; Impact on Existing Features — The draft explicitly lists affected existing features and unaffected areas.; Present Recommendations with Reasoning — Q&A includes recommendations, but the basis is not consistently stated as docs, guardrails, or existing code patterns for each question.; Explore Before Asking — Cannot verify from the draft alone whether docs/code were explored before asking questions.; Proactively Raise Related Implications — The draft proactively covers related implications such as missing pointer/report handling and feature impact boundaries.; Confirm Brainstorm vs. Decision Before Critiquing — Cannot determine from the draft alone whether brainstorming-vs-decision was confirmed before critique.; Capture Digressions in draft.md — No digression is evident in the provided draft content, so this is inapplicable.; Draft Stays at Requirements Level — Draft includes implementation-level details (exact file paths, internal pointer file design, stderr message strings) beyond pure requirements level.; Backward-Compatible CLI Interface — No removal or semantic change of existing CLI commands/options is specified; migration plan is not required.

entries.reason: REQ-SPEC — Diff covers pointer write (R3), prompt update (R2), and command registration, but lacks the actual `run-report-show.js` implementation and required unit tests for success/failure paths (R1/R4/R5), so spec is not fully implemented.
REQ-SPEC — 主要要件（showコマンド追加、ポインタ書き出し、prompt更新、異常系テスト追加）は実装されているが、`flow report show` 実装が `report.json.text` に末尾改行が無い場合に改行を付与しており、要件R1の『改行整形無しで stdout に流す』に厳密一致していない。

REQ-SPEC — R2/R3/R4/R5 and related unit tests are implemented, but R1 is not strictly met because `run-report-show.js` appends a trailing newline when `report.json.text` lacks one (`process.stdout.write(text.endsWith("\n") ? text : text + "\n")`), violating the spec’s ‘no reformatting’ requirement.
